title: Senior Level Designer
description:
Blackbird Interactive is a creative-fueled, future-driven, independent game studio where the best talent in the industry can find long-term careers to help grow their abilities while working on a wide range of projects, which encompass world-class IPs as well as our own creations across multiple genres.

 

Our studio operates as a remote-first workplace, offering flexible work arrangements.

 

PLEASE NOTE: At this time, we are only able to hire candidates who are legally eligible to work in Canada and reside within Canada.


Blackbird Interactive is looking for an experienced Senior Level Designer to help build and deliver high-quality gameplay spaces for an action RPG focused on fast-paced combat, character progression, exploration, and replayability. This role focuses on designing levels, encounters, and environments that create satisfying combat opportunities, reward exploration, and support a wide variety of player builds and abilities.

You'll work closely with systems design, combat design, art, narrative, audio, and engineering to create spaces that complement the game's core combat systems while providing strong pacing, readability, and a sense of discovery. The role involves collaborating with leadership to align content with the overall creative vision while owning levels end-to-end, from initial layout and blockout through implementation, iteration, and polish. As a senior designer, you'll be expected to independently solve complex level design problems, provide strong design judgment, and help establish a high quality bar for playable content across the game.

\n


Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with combat, systems, narrative, art, engineering, audio, and production to create levels that support the established creative vision and core gameplay pillars

  • Own levels end-to-end, including layouts, blockouts, combat spaces, encounters, traversal, exploration, pacing, and player flow

  • Design engaging combat spaces that support varied enemies, character builds, abilities, positioning, and different approaches to combat

  • Create rewarding exploration through optional paths, secrets, environmental storytelling, and meaningful rewards while maintaining clear navigation and progression

  • Script and implement gameplay events, encounters, objectives, triggers, and environmental interactions directly in engine

  • Test, debug, and iterate on levels using playtest feedback to improve combat flow, difficulty, pacing, readability, and replayability


Requirements

  • A minimum of 8 years of game development experience, with significant experience designing and implementing levels for action, RPG, or combat focused games

  • Experience shipping multiple titles, including at least one in a senior or equivalent level design role

  • Proven ability to independently own complex levels from initial concept and blockout through implementation, iteration, and final polish

  • Strong understanding of action RPG level design, including combat spaces, encounter pacing, exploration, progression, player guidance, and replayability

  • Strong hands-on experience with level editing, gameplay scripting, and in-engine implementation, with the ability to prototype, debug, and iterate quickly

  • Strong design judgment, communication, and collaboration skills, with the ability to balance gameplay quality, creative goals, technical constraints, and production realities


Pluses

  • Passion for action RPGs centered on combat, character builds, loot, progression, and exploration

  • Experience designing levels for an isometric or elevated gameplay camera, with an understanding of its impact on combat readability, navigation, and composition

  • Experience creating replayable content that supports different character builds, abilities, difficulty levels, or repeated playthroughs

  • Appreciation for systemic combat and how level geometry, enemy composition, hazards, and interactive elements combine to create varied encounters

  • Experience designing dungeons, interconnected environments, procedural or modular level content, or other repeatable gameplay spaces

  • Strong instincts for environmental storytelling, gameplay readability, polish, and identifying opportunities to improve the player experience through iteration


\n

description:

Our People

With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

Our Impact

Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. Weâre proud to be a part of that.Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts

About the Role

You have spent 7+ years designing complex digital products, ideally including SaaS, B2B, platform, workflow-heavy or similarly sophisticated product experiences, and are ready to shape product direction, design standards and team culture across one or more product pillars.

As a lead individual contributor, you will partner deeply with product and engineering leaders, mentor other designers and help teams define and improve strategically important product experiences across the HighLevel platform. What We Are Looking For

  • 7+ years of relevant product design experience, with 2+ years in a leadership, mentorship or design direction capacity; experience in SaaS, B2B, platform, workflow-heavy or other complex digital product environments is highly valuable.

  • An exceptionally strong portfolio that demonstrates systematic thinking, customer empathy, exceptional craft, measurable product impact and leadership beyond individual execution.

  • Proven experience leading data-informed product design across the full lifecycle, including research, information architecture, interaction design, visual design, prototyping, content strategy and usability testing.

  • Exceptional visual and interaction design craft, with deep care for hierarchy, layout, typography, grids, spacing, motion, usability, accessibility and product quality.

  • Experience designing for AI-driven or intelligent interfaces, including collaboration with machine learning, data, automation or platform teams.

  • Deep fluency in design systems, accessibility standards, reusable patterns and scalable product experience decisions.

  • Experience influencing design direction for high-impact product areas, systems, platforms or pillars, not only individual features or flows.

  • Strong cross-functional leadership skills and the ability to work fluently with product managers, engineers, data partners, customer-facing teams, senior stakeholders and other designers.

  • Excellent communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to simplify complex ideas, lead critiques and workshops and persuade through rationale, evidence and craft.

  • Passion for improving team operations, design standards, processes, tools, documentation and better ways for teams to work.

In This Role, You Will

  • Lead design strategy and execution for one or more product pillars from discovery through delivery.

  • Translate customer needs, business goals, product strategy and technical constraints into clear experience direction and design roadmaps.

  • Partner with product and engineering leaders to define product vision, prioritize opportunities and align teams around high-quality outcomes.

  • Influence leadership decisions through customer empathy, data synthesis, product judgment, storytelling and strong design rationale.

  • Drive design quality reviews and set standards for usability, accessibility, interaction quality, visual consistency and design system alignment.

  • Raise the quality of multiple teams by mentoring designers, improving critique, strengthening shared patterns and making standards easier to adopt.

  • Define and socialize metrics for design quality and impact, such as usability signals, accessibility compliance, task success, adoption, retention or customer satisfaction.

  • Lead complex discovery and design efforts through ambiguity by synthesizing inputs, framing decisions and helping teams move with clarity.

How You Work

  • You raise the bar for craft, visual sophistication and product quality across the teams around you.

  • You move comfortably between product strategy, customer insight, systems thinking and hands-on design execution.

title: Member of Technical Staff Engineering
description:
Overview

Physical Superintelligence is a startup with roots at Google, NVIDIA, Harvard, Meta, MIT, Oxford, Johns Hopkins, Cambridge, and the Perimeter Institute building AI systems to discover new physics at scale. We are seeking engineers to build platform infrastructure at the intersection of computational science, AI systems, and software engineering.

Our mission is to discover and commercialize transformative physics breakthroughs at scale with artificial superintelligence, safely, verifiably, and for broad public benefit.

The last century's golden age of physics gave us transistors, lasers, and nuclear energy. We believe artificial superintelligence will unlock the next one. We're creating the infrastructure to industrialize scientific discovery and usher in this new era.

We have one product: new physics, at scale.

Use this application if you are an engineer, no open engineering role fits your profile, and you want to be considered anyway. We hire excellent engineers when we find them, whether or not a matching role is open. Tell us how your background and ambitions intersect with our mission, and where you would have the most impact.

Â 

Role and Responsibilities

  • Our platform spans distributed systems, data infrastructure, agent systems and evaluation, HPC and scientific computing, developer platforms, product engineering, cloud infrastructure, and security. This application is for engineers who are strong across most of that list, or unusually deep in something important we did not list. The bar here is higher than any single posting.

  • The standard is the same as every engineering role here: full ownership from spec to ship to on-call, and systems other people build on.

  • Be specific about where you would have the most impact and what you would work on first.

  • We review these applications on a rolling basis and respond only when we see a strong fit.

What We're Looking For

  • A track record of shipping substantive engineering work: systems that shipped and mattered, open source people depend on, infrastructure that outlived your tenure. We weight evidence over credentials.

  • Depth in several of the areas above and the range to move between them, or singular depth in something important we did not list.

  • You can walk us through a hard technical decision you made, what you traded away, and what you would do differently.

  • A concrete reason to be here. If AI systems and physical science together is why you are applying, say so specifically.

Nice to Have

  • Background in any of our named areas: distributed systems, data infrastructure, agent systems and evals, HPC and scientific computing, developer platforms, product engineering, infrastructure, or security.

  • Experience in research or scientific computing environments.

  • Something we can read or run: a design doc, a paper, a repo, a postmortem.

Â 

How We Work

We hold a high technical bar and give people full ownership of their work, from spec to ship to on-call. We write contracts before logic, test against real systems instead of mocks, and favor simple designs that ship over clever ones that do not. Our development process is AI-native: we work with agentic coding tools daily, write specs that are legible to humans and agents alike, and lead with leverage.

Â 

Location and Compensation

This role is based in Boston. We will consider remote candidates on a case-by-case basis. We offer competitive compensation including salary, benefits, and meaningful early-stage equity. We evaluate on technical breadth, systems thinking, scientific curiosity, and shipping velocity. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diverse perspectives in building platforms for AI-driven discovery.

title: Surveyor I
description:
Job Description

The Surveyor I is an entry or junior-level position for new graduates and/or those candidates with less than five (5) years of experience in an applicable industry. The Surveyor I, under a direct supervisor, performs work involving conventional surveying practices. The primary function is to develop the ability to effectively examine and report on vessels and other marine structures during and after construction relative to compliance with the applicable requirements for maintaining the vessel in Classification with ABS and meeting associated statutory and special service requirements related to Safety of Life at Sea, Loadline, Tonnage, Cargo Gear and Pollution Prevention Certification.

What You Will Do (with the assistance and guidance of an experienced ABS Surveyor):

  • Acts as a professional specialist for the organization in the application of related rules, regulations, requirements, concepts, principles, and processes.
  • Performs routine surveys on classed vessels, platforms, or other marine structures and at manufacturers for classification and compliance with statutory requirements.
  • Prepares technically accurate and timely reports of inspections and surveys performed.
  • Engages in contact with clients to resolve problems within areas of expertise.
  • Maintains survey files in an orderly and up-to-date manner in the area of responsibility.
  • Develops the skills necessary for the administration of office procedures and monitoring of business performance at an assigned port.
  • Through broader and more technically challenging work assignments, the individual must develop a thorough understanding of field operations, policies, methods, and procedures.

What You Will Need:

Education and Experience

  • Qualifications from a tertiary institution within a relevant field of engineering or physical science (minimum two (2) years program); or
  • Qualifications from a marine or nautical institution and relevant seagoing experience as a certificated ship officer, and
  • Proficiency in the English language commensurate with the scope of statutory certification and services and, before assignment, with their future work.
  • Appropriate certification and/or licenses in areas of specialization may be required.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

  • Ability to develop a working knowledge of ABS Rules, Guides, statutory regulations, and related instructions, as well as the ABS Employee Safety Policy.
  • Ability to read engineering plans and have a basic understanding of shipbuilding practices and vessel operations.
  • Ability to perform surveys in the prescribed format.
  • Knowledge of computer programs or software packages related to job responsibilities.
  • Knowledge of related technical interfaces required for group project work.
  • Knowledge of ships' engineering systems and machinery.
  • Ability to communicate, orally and in writing, pertinent information relative to assigned area of technical expertise.
  • Ability to analyze problems and propose solutions.
  • Responsiveness to customers and the ability to work well with others.
  • Ability to become familiar with the ABS Health, Safety, Quality, and Environmental Management Systems.

Physical Requirements:

  • Where allowed by local laws, a pre-employment physical examination is mandatory.
  • The role of surveyor/auditor requires sufficient physical strength, stamina, agility, and both visual and auditory acuity to perform the listed duties effectively.
  • The ability to climb vertical ladders up to nine meters and navigate steep steps is essential.
  • Shall be capable of working at heights on various staging and lifting equipment.
  • Shall be able to maneuver in tight spaces and work inside confined areas for extended periods, including kneeling and crawling.
  • The role may involve exposure to industrial environments, potential injury risks, extreme weather conditions, and demanding physical activities.
  • Shall be able to lift at least 25 lbs. / 11.34 kgs.
  • The use of small tools and the wearing of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE), in accordance with ABS safety procedures, may be required.
  • Where allowed by local laws, the surveyor will be required to successfully complete an annual physical that will recertify the individual can perform the physical actions required.

Reporting Relationships:

Will report to the Principal, Senior, or Surveyor-in-Charge of the assigned port. This position does not have any direct reports.

About Us

We set out more than 160 years ago to promote the security of life and property at sea and preserve the natural environment. Today, we remain true to our mission and continue to support organizations facing a rapidly evolving seascape of challenging regulations and new technologies. Through it all, we are anchored by a vision and mission that help our clients find clarity in uncertain times.

ABS is a global leader in marine and offshore classification and other innovative safety, quality, and environmental services. Weâre at the forefront of supporting the global energy transition at sea, the application of remote and autonomous marine systems, cutting-edge technical solutions, and many more exciting advancements. Our commitment to safety, reliability, and efficiency is ever-present, guiding our clients to safer and more efficient operations.

Equal Opportunity

ABS Bureau is committed to the equal employment opportunity of its employees and prohibits discrimination against any employee or qualified applicant based on race, color, creed, religion, national origin, sex, gender identity, age, disability, marital status, sexual orientation, citizenship status or veteran status, or other non-work-related characteristics that may be protected under the law of the Federal Government or specific state employment laws.

ABS and Affiliated Companies (ABS) will not pay a fee to any third-party agency without a valid ABS Master Service Agreement (MSA) authorized and signed by Human Resources. Any resume, CV, application, or other forms of candidate submission provided to any employee of ABS without a valid MSA on file will be considered property of ABS, and no fee will be paid.

Other

title: Head of Security
description:
Tremendous is the global platform built for businesses to send payoutsâgift cards and moneyâto anyone, anywhere, instantly. We're trusted by 20,000+ organizations, from startups to giants like Atlassian, MIT, and United Way, to reach millions of recipients worldwide.

We're profitable and growing without outside investors. We're fully remote, with a high-documentation, low-meeting culture that leaves more time for the work that mattersâand for your life outside it. Our employee NPS sits in the high 80s.

We move billions of dollars through our systems. That makes security existential, and it's why we're making our first dedicated security hire.

About The Role

You'll be our first Head of Security. There's already a real foundation hereâbug bounty, pen tests, automated code and configuration scanning on the production and code side, phishing simulations on the people side. Youâll add to it across access and identity, SecOps and monitoring, incident response, vendor security, employee security practices, and policy. You'll own the whole posture.

This is a player-coach role. Early on, you'll do the scoping and the hands-on work yourself; this is not a role where you direct from above. As the work demands it, we're fully prepared to build a team hereâand we're looking to you to define what that team should be and when.

You'll report to the VP of Engineering, Tremendous' most senior technical leader. We've deliberately placed security with Engineering so you're set up to drive real implementation fastâembedded with the people whose work you're securing, not siloed in a compliance function. As the security function matures, we'll revisit this.

What You'll Do

  • Own Tremendous' security posture end-to-end, partnering with our engineering team on production infrastructure and code security.
  • Assess where we have gaps, prioritize them, and tackle our highest-leverage gaps first. Weâll have opinions, but you own the prioritization and implementation.
  • Treat incident response as core, not afterthought. We may not be able to prevent a breach, but your job is making sure it's small, contained, and that we know exactly what to do.
  • Drive security as a cultural shift across the companyâintroducing controls incrementally, working with teams rather than over them. "Yes, and," not "no."
  • Lead our AI-security posture. We invest heavily in AI tooling; your job is to manage that risk and enable it, not to ban it.
  • Define when and how to staff up the security function, and hire your own team.

What You'll Bring

  • Real, hands-on security experience at a company that scaledâideally as an early security hire who grew with the business through high growth.
  • Deep experience in at least one core security domainâproduct/production security, security operations, or access/identity and policyâwith enough range to reason across the others. You defined the security posture, not just executed someone elseâs playbook.
  • An engineer's mindset. You reach for code to solve problems and can read our codebase and understand our infrastructure (Ruby on Rails; TypeScript + React; PostgreSQL; Google Cloud). You won't write much day-to-day, but you're not lost in the code.
  • Judgment over checklists. You can explain the actual risk of a given decision, hold a firm line where it matters, and give ground where "best practice" doesn't apply to us or real business need pulls the other way. You can hold your own in a debate about whether to open up broad data access for AI tooling.
  • Bedside manner. You drive hard change by bringing the team around to your point of view, rather than just telling them no. Engineers and the rest of the company want to work with you.
  • Experience building or co-building a small security team is a plus.
  • Fintech, payments, or regulated-industry experience is a plus.

What's Cool About The Role

  • You define the function. First security leader, with the budget for the required tools and team.
  • A real mandate. The push for this hire comes straight from the founders.
  • We invest in your tools. Everyone has a $5k/month budget for AI tools. Use it.
  • Competitive pay and equity. Base salary $250,000â$330,000, plus meaningful equity.
  • Fully remote. Work from anywhere in the Americas.
  • Great culture. Read more about how we work in our public handbook.

Compensation Range: $250K - $330K

title: Data Analyst Assistant
description:
About the role
 The Data Analyst Assistant role is central to our current engagement with a Dubai-based investment firm that requires precise data handling and clear visualization. This position provides the quantitative groundwork that allows our principals to form a view on complex corporate governance and strategy questions. We need an assistant who can organize messy data sets into logical structures that reveal the health and performance of a holding company.

About Arabian Private Holdings
 Arabian Private Holdings was founded on the principle that many critical business problems do not fit the traditional large-firm consulting model. A board facing a succession question or a family group weighing a capital injection does not need a team of twelve associates and a hundred-page methodology deck. They need experienced partners who can sit with a problem, form a rigorous view, and defend it. We take on a limited number of mandates to ensure that every client receives direct attention from the principals who are actually accountable for the outcome. Our work covers corporate strategy, governance, and operating model efficiency for some of the most significant family groups, listed corporations, and government entities in the region. We focus on clarity over complexity. We operate as a remote firm, choosing to prioritize the quality of our analysis and the strength of our relationships over traditional office overhead or aggressive growth targets.

What you will do
  • Collect and organize financial and operational data from various portfolio companies for a Dubai-based investment.
  • Clean and validate data sets to ensure accuracy before they are used in client presentations.
  • Build simple, effective spreadsheets that track performance indicators for large holding companies.
  • Assist in drafting reports that translate numbers into clear written arguments for our principals.
  • Monitor industry trends and perform basic market research to support ongoing strategic mandates.
  • Maintain internal records to ensure that historical client data is easily accessible and correctly categorized.
  • Prepare charts and graphs that simplify complex financial structures for board-level reviews.
  • Support the audit of corporate governance documents by cross-referencing quantitative findings with qualitative reports.


What we are looking for
  • A clear understanding of basic statistics and a logical approach to problem-solving.
  • Proficiency in spreadsheet software with an ability to manage large amounts of information without errors.
  • Strong written skills and the ability to explain what a set of numbers means in plain English.
  • Curiosity about how large corporations and family groups operate in different sectors.
  • Precision in your work, where you check your own calculations before submitting them for review.
  • A degree or ongoing studies in a quantitative field such as economics, finance, or mathematics.


How we work
 We operate as a fully remote firm, which means we rely on clear documentation and asynchronous communication. Because our work involves sensitive mandates for high-profile clients, we maintain a high standard of professional conduct and data security. You will work closely with a principal who provides direct mentorship and expects you to form your own view on the data you analyze. We do not value long hours for the sake of appearances. Instead, we focus on the rigor of the output and the clarity of the logic. This remote model allows us to hire individuals based on their intellectual capability rather than their physical location, ensuring we can provide the best possible advice to our clients.

What the role offers
  • A paid entry-level position with a competitive compensation package for the current market.
  • Direct exposure to high-level corporate strategy and governance mandates.
  • Mentorship from experienced principals who have managed some of the largest holding companies in the region.
  • The flexibility of a permanent, full-time role that is entirely remote.
  • Practical experience in forming a rigorous view on business performance and portfolio health.

title: Data Entry Administrator
description:
About PulseMediaNL

PulseMediaNL is a forward-thinking digital media company committed to delivering high-quality content, innovative marketing solutions, and exceptional customer experiences. We value accuracy, efficiency, collaboration, and continuous improvement. As our team grows, we are seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Data Entry Administrator to support our daily operations by maintaining accurate and reliable data across multiple platforms.

Position Overview

The Data Entry Administrator is responsible for accurately entering, updating, verifying, and maintaining company data while ensuring the highest standards of quality and confidentiality. This role requires excellent attention to detail, strong organizational skills, and the ability to work independently in a remote environment. The successful candidate will help ensure that business records remain complete, accurate, and accessible, contributing directly to operational efficiency.

Key Responsibilities

  • Accurately enter data into company databases, spreadsheets, and internal management systems.
  • Review and verify information for completeness, accuracy, and consistency before submission.
  • Update existing records with new information while maintaining data integrity.
  • Identify and correct errors, inconsistencies, or duplicate entries.
  • Organize and maintain digital files, records, and documentation.
  • Perform routine data quality checks and audits.
  • Generate reports and summaries as requested by management.
  • Assist with importing and exporting data between various software platforms.
  • Maintain confidential information in accordance with company policies and applicable privacy regulations.
  • Collaborate with internal departments to obtain missing or updated information.
  • Prioritize tasks to meet deadlines while maintaining a high level of accuracy.
  • Support administrative projects and perform additional data-related tasks as assigned.

Required Qualifications

  • High school diploma or equivalent; an associate's or bachelor's degree is an advantage.
  • Previous experience in data entry, administrative support, or office administration preferred.
  • Excellent typing skills with a high level of accuracy.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to producing error-free work.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel and Word.
  • Experience using Google Workspace, including Google Sheets and Google Docs.
  • Comfortable learning and using new software and database systems.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Reliable internet connection and a suitable remote work environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with CRM or ERP software.
  • Familiarity with database management systems.
  • Knowledge of data privacy and information security best practices.
  • Experience working remotely in a professional environment.
  • Basic analytical and problem-solving skills.

Key Skills

  • Data entry accuracy
  • Time management
  • Organization
  • Attention to detail
  • Communication
  • Problem-solving
  • Computer literacy
  • Multitasking
  • Confidentiality
  • Team collaboration

What We Offer

  • Fully remote work environment.
  • Competitive salary.
  • Flexible working schedule where applicable.
  • Paid time off and company holidays.
  • Opportunities for professional development and career growth.
  • Supportive and collaborative team culture.
  • Ongoing training and skill development.
  • Performance recognition and advancement opportunities.
  • Access to modern digital collaboration tools.

Success in This Role

The ideal candidate consistently delivers accurate work, meets deadlines, maintains confidentiality, communicates effectively with colleagues, and demonstrates a proactive approach to improving data quality and administrative processes.

Equal Opportunity Employer

PulseMediaNL is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where all employees are treated with respect and provided equal opportunities.

If you are a detail-oriented professional who enjoys working with data and thrives in a remote environment, we encourage you to apply and become part of the PulseMediaNL team.

description:
At Flix, we offer a dynamic work environment with competitive pay, strong growth opportunities, and a tech-driven approach to making travel more accessible, sustainable, and affordable.  

As Senior/Expert HR Tech Solution Architect, you will join the People & Organization Digital Transformation team to help shape and transform Flix's global HR technology landscape.

Together with FlixTech, you will support the architecture, integration landscape and governance framework across a complex, multi-entity and multi-country organization — ensuring our technology enables Flix's future HR target operating model. The role reports to the Head of Digital Transformation and works closely with the People Enablement Tech stream, FlixTech, IT Security, Data Privacy and HR teams globally.

You will help set the technical and architectural direction that the wider team — including our AI & Automation Engineers and HR Tech Business Analysts — builds within.

This role is based in Munich, given the global scope, regular collaboration with colleagues across European, APAC and US time zones is required.  

About the Role

  • Work closely with FlixTech, shape Flix's target HR technology architecture across core HRIS, payroll, time & attendance, talent, recruiting, document management and surrounding enterprise systems — ensuring the architecture enables our HR target operating and service-delivery model by connecting processes, roles, systems and service tiers while balancing global standards with local requirements.
  • Drive global HRIS transformation initiatives, from major platform revamps and redesigns to potential HRIS migrations — evaluating technology options, building business cases, structuring programs through project plans and RAID/risk frameworks, and driving execution through solution design, integrations, testing, cutover, parallel runs and stabilization.
  • Define HR technology integrations and data flows between the HRIS and surrounding enterprise systems — determining what data moves between systems and through which integration patterns, including REST APIs, OAuth 2.0, webhooks, SFTP, middleware and event-driven architectures.
  • Establish and evolve HR technology governance and control frameworks, including system ownership and RACI, security and role-model design, least privilege and segregation of duties, audit trails, change/release governance, internal controls and data privacy aligned with GDPR and audit/IPO-readiness expectations.
  • Act as the bridge between HR functional and technology teams, translating business and process requirements into target-state solutions and executable designs, and driving global HR technology implementation projects from requirements through go-live.

About You

  • 8+ years of experience in HR technology transformation, HRIS, solution architecture, enterprise architecture or HRIS delivery, with a degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Business Technology or a related field.
  • Strong HR domain and Workday expertise, with an understanding of how core HRIS, payroll, time & attendance, talent, recruiting and surrounding enterprise systems work together across a global HR technology landscape. Any Workday certifications would be an advantage.
  • Demonstrable experience driving Workday transformations, including major Workday redesigns, platform revamps and/or migrations end to end. Hands-on enterprise Workday experience across configuration, integration or migration is a strong differentiator.
  • Strong integration and systems architecture knowledge, including REST APIs, OAuth 2.0, webhooks, SFTP, middleware, data flows and event-driven architectures across complex enterprise environments.
  • Experience supporting the design of HR target operating models, HR service-delivery models and technology governance frameworks, including security and role models, segregation of duties, audit trails, internal controls and data privacy in regulated, multi-country environments.
  • Experience with cloud architecture and AI & automation technologies is critical, including areas such as Claude/GenAI deployment, MCPs, n8n and Rovo Agents, alongside strong Jira project-management capabilities.
  • Fluency in English. Certifications in solution/enterprise architecture, project management, agile or automation (e.g. TOGAF, PMP, SAFe, Scrum, Six Sigma, n8n) are a plus.

We recognize that everyone carries a unique set of valuable skills and experiences. If you think you could have an impact even though you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply. We want to hear from you!  

What We Offer

  • Travel perks: 12 free Flix vouchers + 12 discount vouchers for friends & family. 
  • Work from (M)Anywhere: Depending on your role, work from another location for up to 60 days per year. 
  • Hybrid work model: We are an office-first company, but we offer flexibility to balance work and life. 
  • Wellbeing support: Access confidential 1:1 counselling, courses, and stress management for yourself and up to four family members. 
  • Learning & Development: Take advantage of language classes, training courses, and expert-led sessions to grow your skills.

Genau da kommst du ins Spiel: Du machst aus mitlaufenden Kanälen eine eigenständige FlixTrain-Präsenz. Du bekommst einen Startpunkt mit Reichweite, aber freie Hand beim Aufbau von Strategie, Struktur, Prozessen und Partner-Setup. Du entscheidest, wo wir spielen und wo nicht, übersetzt die FlixTrain-Marke plattformgerecht und machst Wirkung messbar. Die Rolle ist Teil des Brand Teams und bewusst als eigenverantwortliche Aufbaurolle angelegt: Du bist In-House-Kopf und Taktgeber, die Produktion steuerst du über Agentur, Creator und internes Creative Team. 

Entscheidend ist eine Haltung: Nähe zum Zeitgeist, ohne jedem Trend hinterherzulaufen. Wir wollen Reichweite mit Substanz: Content, der zur Marke passt, nicht bloße Content-Masse. 

Über die Rolle 

Strategie & Where-to-play 

  • Du entwickelst die Organic-Social-Strategie für FlixTrain: klare Ziele, Zielgruppen und Kommunikations-Säulen: abgeleitet aus der übergeordneten Markenstrategie, nicht als Insel. 
  • Du triffst die Where-to-play-Entscheidung: Du prüfst die bestehenden Kanäle, entscheidest, welche wir fokussieren und welche bewusst nicht, und identifizierst, wo FlixTrain zusätzlich präsent sein sollte. 
  • Du definierst das Zusammenspiel aus „Big Moment"-Ideen (große, reichweitenstarke Momente, die kulturelle Relevanz schaffen) und Ongoing-Community-Content (kontinuierlich, näher an der bestehenden Community)  

Markenübersetzung & Content 

  • Du übersetzt die FlixTrain-Marke plattformnativ – nicht als adaptierten Kampagnen-Cutdown, sondern als eigenständige, kanaltypische Formate, die organisch wirken statt „gebrandet". 
  • Du sorgst dafür, dass Content zum Zeitgeist UND zur Marke passt: Du kombinierst Entertainment- und Kultur-Trends mit echtem Markenfit – kein Trend-Hopping, kein „AI-Slop", kein Content um des Contents willen. 
  • Du betreibst Community Management, hältst die Marke im Dialog präsent und behältst auch bei kritischen Themen einen souveränen Ton – mit dem Gespür, wann ein Fall an PR gehört. 

Partner- & Produktions-Setup 

  • Du baust das richtige Partner-Setup auf und steuerst es. Darüber hinaus managst du das Budget eigenverantwortlich und entscheidest, welche Inhalte gezielt verstärkt werden. 

Measurement & Wirkung 

  • Du machst die Wirkung von Organic Social mit den richtigen KPIs je Zielstellung und Maßnahme messbar — von Big-Moment Content bis hin zu Ongoing-Content — und etablierst ein durchdachtes Reporting, aus dem du gezielt Learnings für die nächste Planungsrunde ableitest. 

Stakeholder & Schnittstellen 

  • Du arbeitest eng mit dem Brand Team, dem FlixBus Social Media Team und dem Creative Team zusammen und sorgst für strategische Konsistenz zwischen Organic, Paid und Kampagne. 
  • Du bist Sparringspartner für interne Stakeholder und externe Partner und vertrittst Social souverän gegenüber Management und Fachbereichen. 

Über Dich 

  • Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung im Organic-Social- bzw. Content-Marketing – idealerweise mit Erfahrung auf Unternehmens- und Agenturseite. 
  • Du bist Generalist: Du denkst strategisch (Where-to-play, KPIs, Positionierung) und bleibst gleichzeitig hands-on in Redaktionsplanung, Briefing und Steuerung. 
  • Du hast Social-Strukturen oder -Kanäle aufgebaut oder maßgeblich geprägt, nicht nur verwaltet – du bringst Ownership und Aufbau-Mentalität mit. 
  • Du bist nah am Zeitgeist und kannst Entertainment-/Kultur-Trends lesen – aber mit dem Urteilsvermögen, sie am Markenfit zu messen und auch Nein zu sagen. 
  • Du steuerst Agenturen, Creator und Freelancer sicher und behältst Budget, Timings und Qualität im Blick. 
  • Du nutzt KPIs, Social Listening und Insights selbstverständlich als Grundlage von Entscheidungen – und erkennst den Unterschied zwischen Reichweite und Wirkung. 
  • Du kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch und Englisch (jeweils mind. C1-Niveau). 

Bei uns zählt der Blick auf das Ganze – auch wenn du nicht alle Anforderungen zu 100 % erfüllst, aber dennoch glaubst, hier etwas bewegen zu können, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung. 

Was Wir Bieten 

  • Reisevorteile: 12 kostenlose Flix-Gutscheine + 12 Rabattgutscheine für Freunde & Familie. 
  • Arbeiten von überall: Je nach Rolle bis zu 60 Tage pro Jahr von einem anderen Standort aus. 
  • Hybrides Arbeitsmodell: Bürokultur mit Flexibilität, um Arbeit und Leben in Einklang zu bringen. 
  • Gesundheits- und Wohlfühlangebote: Zugang zu vertraulichen Einzelberatungen, Kursen und Maßnahmen zur Stressbewältigung – für dich und bis zu vier Familienangehörige. 
  • Lernen & Entwicklung: Sprachkurse, Schulungen und Experten-Sessions, um deine Fähigkeiten auszubauen. 
  • Mentoring-Programm: Vernetze dich mit erfahrenen Kolleginnen und Kollegen, um Einblicke zu gewinnen und deine Karriere zu beschleunigen. 

 

Warum Teil von Flix werden? 

Bei Flix konzentrieren wir uns darauf, Reisen einfach, sicher und preiswert zu gestalten – sowohl für unsere Passagiere als auch für unsere Mitarbeiter. Hier geht es schnell voran, und es gibt viel Raum, etwas zu bewegen. Wir wachsen und entwickeln uns täglich weiter und suchen Menschen, die bereit sind, sich einzubringen und die Art und Weise, wie wir arbeiten, mitzugestalten. 

Wenn du einen Job suchst, in dem du wachsen und etwas bewirken kannst, dann bist du bei FlixTrain genau richtig. Hier kannst du Teil eines Teams werden, in dem dein Beitrag zählt und du deine Reise selbst gestalten kannst!

title: Enterprise Account Executive (m/f/d)
description:
Your wellbeing, our mission. Join a company shaping a healthier world.

GET TO KNOW US

At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. Our platform connects employees worldwide to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription. Headquartered in NYC with team members in Europe, North America and South America, we're on a mission to make every company a wellness company.

We believe work should be fulfilling, inspiring, and balanced. Here, you'll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally. 

Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing!

 

THE OPPORTUNITY

Our Sales team is the driving force behind Wellhub's new customer acquisition and growth across Germany. As a Enterprise Account Executive, you will be key in expanding Wellhub's Germany client book focusing on Mid-market and Enterprise prospects. You will build strategic partnerships with key decision-makers, crafting personalized solutions that address their unique challenges.

This role offers a significant opportunity for both professional and financial growth, with a competitive compensation package that directly rewards your results. We seek a collaborator who is passionate about achieving excellence, thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, and shares our commitment to fostering a positive and supportive team culture. If you possess an entrepreneurial spirit, a desire to lead by example, and a passion for building meaningful relationships with clients, we encourage you to apply. This is a hybrid role with the expectation to be in the office 1X / week.

YOUR IMPACT

  • New Business Development: Engage with new strategic accounts to uncover new revenue opportunities and develop customised solutions that meet the needs of Enterprise prospects (+501 FTEs in Germany).
  • Senior Stakeholder Management: Build and maintain long-term relationships with senior stakeholders, including C-suite executives, Reward Directors, and Wellbeing leaders. Ensure that Wellhub is not only aligned with business goals but also drives tangible, measurable results.
  • Pipeline Generation: Work closely  with our Sales Development team to strategise on opening new opportunities as well complete personal pipeline generation to ensure steady and consistent pipeline.
  • Account Strategy Development: Develop and implement strategic account plans that focus on delivering impactful business outcomes—whether improving talent attraction, enhancing spend efficiency, or reducing Private Medical costs.
  • Industry Engagement: Represent Wellhub at key industry events, forums, and conferences, showcasing our vision and capabilities in shaping the future of Employee Wellbeing.
  • Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life wellness.

WHO YOU ARE

  • Proven Success in SaaS Sales: Experience in enterprise sales new logo acquisition(501+ FTEs in Germany ) with a strong track record of driving revenue growth and working on ticket sizes of £100K - £500K+.
  • Expertise in Strategic Account Management: Experience in managing complex sales cycles (6 months+), developing new business opportunities, and fostering long-term relationships within a target-driven environment.
  • Strong Stakeholder Engagement: Comfortably engage with C-suite executives, key decision-makers, and senior stakeholders across HR, finance, and business functions to align solutions with customer needs.
  • Complex Sales Expertise: Skilled at managing multi-phase sales cycles, navigating intricate procurement and compliance processes, and presenting compelling value propositions to senior leadership.
  • Communication Skills: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex concepts and present them in an approachable and engaging way.  Comfort and interest in using data effectively in the Sales process
  • Data & Analytical Skills: Strong analytical mindset with the ability to interpret data and present in a compelling way to prospects.  Comfort in using commercial insight to recommend and  simplify investment options to a prospect.
  • Passion for Learning: A deep enthusiasm for the Sales profession and how to constantly improve individually and collectively
  • AI-savvy: We are looking for an individual who is comfortable with generative tools and skilled at crafting effective prompts to enhance daily tasks.

We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don't match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. For this specific role, please note that prior experience in a complex sales cycle, strong analytical mindset and ability to uncover new revenue opportunities are mandatory requirements. 

 

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

With thoughtful benefits, emotional wellbeing resources, and a culture that empowers you to take ownership of your role and your wellbeing, we create an environment where you can thrive in all dimensions of your life. Our benefits include:

WELLHUB:  Free Gold membership with access to onsite gyms and studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental wellbeing support, and more! Add up to three family members to your plan, ensuring access to wellness for those who matter most to you.

FLEXIBLE WORK: As a Flexible First company, we offer hybrid and remote options to give you the freedom to work in a way that suits you. The model for this specific role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. We offer all employees a one-time reimbursement to set up their home office equipment and a monthly work allowance to help cover the costs of working from home.

FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE:  Flexibility for us isn't just about where we work—it also means being able to shape how and when we get things done. Together with their leaders, employees define schedules that align with their time zones, team needs, and personal routines.

PAID TIME OFF: We know how important it is to take time away from work to recharge. Employees receive 30 days paid holiday per year in addition to annual holidays (including an extra holiday on your birthday!).

PARENTAL LEAVE: Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life. Take the time to be present and enjoy your growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents. Parents giving birth are eligible for an extended leave and a ramp-back period to return part-time while they get settled.  

CAREER GROWTH: Access world-class platforms, participate in interactive sessions,  build your personalized development roadmap, and explore internal opportunities. We focus on continuous learning and feedback to support your journey toward personal and professional success. 

CULTURE: You'll join a team of passionate people who come together to break boundaries, support each other, and create a meaningful impact in workplace wellness. We win together, building trust through open communication and a culture where every perspective matters. Learn more about our shared culture and values here. 

And to get a glimpse of life at Wellhub… Follow us on Instagram @lifeatwellhub and LinkedIn!

Wellhub was named a Top Sales Team of 2025!
This is a recognition of the collaboration and impact we create together every day. Ready to be part of a team that's making a real difference? Read more about the award here. 

 

Diversity, Equity, and Belonging at Wellhub

We aim to create a collaborative, supportive, and inclusive space where everyone knows they belong. At Wellhub, we welcome and celebrate your authentic self.

Wellhub is committed to creating a diverse work environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law.

Our commitment to inclusion also extends to how we recognize and reward our people. We're proud to be Syndio Fair Pay Certified, reflecting our ongoing dedication to equitable and fair pay practices across our global team. Read more about it here.

title: AI Security Engineer (f/m/d)
description:
Clariness is looking for an AI Security Engineer (f/m/d) based Germany, UK, SA, or Serbia.
- Full-time; unlimited -

About the role:

This role is about building, operating and continuously improving Clariness' security capabilities across applications, cloud infrastructure and AI systems. As our founding-level security hire, you will establish the security engineering function, define its priorities and work directly with engineering teams to embed effective security controls throughout our technology environment.

As an AI Security Engineer, you would be responsible for:

  • Defining Clariness' security engineering strategy and roadmap, and building and operating the security function across application security, cloud security, AI and LLM security, vulnerability management and supporting security tooling.
  • Working directly with engineering teams on secure system design, threat modelling, penetration testing and vulnerability remediation, while embedding appropriate security controls into development processes and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Owning AI security and governance across LLM-powered features, RAG systems and agentic pipelines, including assessing and mitigating risks covered by the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications.
  • Designing and validating safeguards for AI agents, including sandboxing, privilege and access controls, secure tool use and adversarial red teaming of AI systems.
  • Evaluating, deploying and continuously improving AI-powered security automation, including autonomous vulnerability triage, LLM-powered alert analysis, compliance evidence gathering and AI-assisted threat intelligence.
  • Assessing commercial and open-source security tools based on effectiveness, operational fit and cost, and developing custom solutions where existing tooling does not meet Clariness' requirements.
  • Managing Clariness' IT security compliance programme—including SOC 2 Type II, applicable EU AI Act high-risk obligations, GDPR Article 32 technical measures and GxP IT security controls—while maintaining audit-ready documentation and acting as the primary security liaison for external auditors, regulators, Legal and Compliance.

We would like you to have: 

  • At least five years of hands-on experience in security engineering, application security or information security, with strong technical depth beyond advisory or governance responsibilities.
  • Proven experience building or significantly developing a security programme within a product engineering environment, ideally as an early or founding security hire.
  • Strong practical experience across application security, cloud security, secure software development, threat modelling, penetration testing, vulnerability management and security controls within CI/CD pipelines.
  • Experience assessing, testing or implementing security controls for LLM-powered applications, RAG systems or agentic pipelines.
  • Hands-on experience with AI agents, either building them for security automation or securing them through adversarial testing, sandboxing and privilege controls.
  • Demonstrable compliance experience involving at least one SOC 2 audit cycle, GDPR programme ownership or implementation of EU AI Act requirements, including the ability to produce audit-ready documentation and work with external auditors.
  • Experience in a regulated industry such as clinical research, pharmaceuticals, healthtech or fintech, with knowledge of GxP or comparable regulated data-handling requirements considered a strong advantage, alongside strong English communication skills at C1 level.

You may ask now, why should I work for you? Let us give you a few reasons – and you'll learn more during the process.

  • A varied and exciting job with a lot of personal responsibility in an international company, where you can develop and expand your skills.
  • Professional and personal development opportunities - incl. personal development budget.
  • Flexible working hours and mobile working.
  • Regular team events and open feedback culture.
  • A versatile field of activity and challenging projects.
  • A supportive and open company culture, providing the opportunity to collaborate with a diverse and professional team.
  • Impact healthcare by accelerating medical innovation through improved access to clinical trials, potentially bringing needed treatments to patients faster.

 

How to apply & what to expect: 

  • Apply via link (CV only; no cover letter required).
  • Introductory call (30 min) → Technical interview → Senior Leadership Interview →  Demo Day → Decision.
  • We aim to move promptly and keep you updated at every step. 

 

At Clariness, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees, regardless of race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, disability or age.

For more information, feel free to reach out to

Have we sparked your interest?

Would you like to become part of our dynamic, curious, and international culture with plenty of room for your ideas and creativity in an inspiring atmosphere? If so, we look forward to receiving your application with details of your desired salary and possible starting date, preferably via our application portal.

title: Junior Workplace & Front Desk Manager (f/m/d)
description:
Über uns

Zenjob ist eine KI-gestützte Plattform für flexible Personallösungen, die seit 2015 Unternehmen und temporäre Arbeitskräfte effizient miteinander verbindet. Unternehmen buchen über unsere Plattform kurzfristig einsatzbereite Mitarbeitende in Echtzeit, während Studierende unsere App nutzen, um Nebenjobs zu finden, die sich optimal mit ihrem Studium vereinbaren lassen. Über 40.000 Studierende und 1.000 Partnerunternehmen aus Logistik, Einzelhandel und Gastronomie in allen großen deutschen Städten teilen unseren Glauben daran, dass gute Arbeit kein Zufall ist. Gute Arbeit beginnt hier.

Über die Rolle

In der Rolle als Junior Workplace & Front Desk Agent bist du das Gesicht von Zenjob. Du stellst sicher, dass unser Berliner Office als Visitenkarte des Unternehmens fungiert und der tägliche Betrieb reibungslos abläuft. Du bist die erste Anlaufstelle für unsere “Zennies” (unsere Mitarbeiter) und Gäste und sorgst durch deine Präsenz und dein Organisationstalent für ein professionelles und herzliches Umfeld.

Das machst du bei uns

  • Face of the Company: Dein Hauptarbeitsplatz ist unsere Rezeption. Du begrüßt Gäste, Bewerber und Mitarbeiter mit einer positiven Ausstrahlung und bist die zentrale Anlaufstelle für alle täglichen Anliegen im Office.

  • Front Desk Management: Du verantwortest das gesamte Paket- und Liefermanagement, die Postbearbeitung sowie den Ticket- und E-Mail-Verkehr. Du sorgst dafür, dass Anfragen schnell und lösungsorientiert bearbeitet werden.

  • Workplace Operations: Du hast unser Office stets im Blick. Du kontrollierst Bestände (Büromaterial, Getränke und Snacks) und bestellst diese eigenständig nach. Du stellst sicher, dass Meetingräume und Collab-Spaces immer einsatzbereit und ordentlich sind.

  • Schnittstellenmanagement: Du pflegst den Kontakt zu unseren Stakeholdern (IT, Marketing, Facility Management, Reinigungsdienst und Lieferanten). Du koordinierst Handwerkertermine und sorgst dafür, dass Reparaturen zeitnah umgesetzt werden.

  • Standards & Sicherheit: Du achtest auf die Einhaltung unserer Office-Standards und unterstützt uns aktiv beim Thema Arbeitssicherheit, damit sich alle Zennies im Office sicher und wohl fühlen.

  • Culture & Events (On Top): Du unterstützt das Team bei der Vorbereitung und Durchführung von internen Events und Culture-Initiativen (z. B. Sommer- & Winterfest, Culture Talks, Diversity & Inclusion sowie Corporate Social Responsibility Events).

Das bringst du mit

  • Leidenschaft für den Front Desk: Du liebst die Rolle als Gastgeber:in. Deine Energie ziehst du daraus, im direkten Kontakt mit Menschen zu stehen und ein top-organisiertes Office macht dich am Ende eines Arbeitstages zufrieden.

  • Service-Gen & Hands-on-Mentalität: Du siehst, wo Hilfe benötigt wird, bevor du gefragt wirst. Du arbeitest strukturiert, zuverlässig und scheust dich nicht davor, auch operativ kräftig anzupacken.

  • Präsenz im Office: Dein Job findet dort statt, wo unsere Zennies sind. Da die Besetzung des Front Desks und das physische Office Management deine Kernaufgaben sind, ist Remote-Arbeit in dieser Position nur sehr bedingt möglich.

  • Organisationstalent: Du behältst den Überblick über Lieferungen, Termine und Bestellungen – auch wenn es an der Rezeption mal trubelig wird.

  • Sprachkenntnisse: Du kommunizierst sicher und freundlich auf Deutsch und Englisch. (Englisch ist unsere Firmensprache)

Das bieten wir:

🏖️ Zeit zum Abschalten & Auftanken

  • 28 Urlaubstage (erhöhen sich alle zwei Kalenderjahre um 1 Tag auf maximal 30 Tage für Vollzeitbeschäftigte; bei Teilzeit anteilig entsprechend der Anzahl der Arbeitstage pro Woche)

  • 1 bezahlter Sonderurlaubstag pro Jahr für ehrenamtliche Arbeit

  • 5 Tage bezahlter Bildungsurlaub

  • Möglichkeit für unbezahlten Urlaub

  • 10 bezahlte Tage beim krankheitsbedingten Ausfall deines Kindes

🚀 Weiterentwicklung & Lernen

  • 750 € jährliches Weiterbildungsbudget pro Mitarbeiter:in

  • Zusätzliches Team-Trainingsbudget & interne Workshops

  • Mentoring, Karrierecoachings & Zenjob University

  • 40 € monatliches Guthaben bei NAVIT (ÖPNV, Bike-Sharing u.v.m.)

💪 Gesundheit & Wohlbefinden

  • 30 € monatlicher Zuschuss für Urban Sports Club

  • 25 % Rabatt auf Mitgliedschaften bei FitX

🥗 Verpflegung & Office-Life

  • Monatliches Monday Lunch, kostenlose Getränke, Obst- & Gemüsekorb

  • Bis zu 115,05 €/Monat steuerfreier Essenszuschuss über Circula

  • Snacks & Drinks nach unseren All Hands Meetings

💼 Finanzen & Vorsorge

  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge über Finsurancy zu attraktiven Gruppenkonditionen

  • Übertragungsservice für bestehende betriebliche Rentenverträge

🎉 Kultur & Teamspirit

Dann bewirb dich jetzt und schicke uns deine Unterlagen. Wir freuen uns auf dich!

title: Solutions Integration Architect - SAP
description:

Our North Star is to take the friction out of bringing digital ideas to life, making room for your ideas and productivity.

Developers from some of the biggest companies in the world are using WunderGraph to design and streamline their API environments. We raised our Series A ($7.5 million USD) in March 2025, being backed by eBay, Karma Ventures, and Aspenwood Ventures.

The culture we are creating together is extremely important to us. Read here how we are Building the Company We Always Wanted to Work In.

We invite everyone that wants to join us to understand our Core Beliefs and if you want to make an impact, have your voice heard, and work in a no-BS organization where you can get stuff done, look no further and apply today so we can chat.

Our Senior Talent Partner has moved into the Head of People and Talent role, so we're looking for someone to take over day-to-day hiring processes for the whole company. We're growing across every team, and you'll be the person who makes sure each of them gets great people when they need them.

This is a full-cycle role first. You'll own searches end to end, from shaping the brief with a hiring manager to closing the offer. Roughly half your roles will be in engineering and half in other functions, so one week you're calibrating an engineering loop and the next you're hiring for sales or operations. A lot of the people we want aren't looking, so you'll find many of them yourself.

The other part of the job is building a talent community around WunderGraph. We're an open-source company with a real developer community, and hiring should draw on that. Events, content, memes, a community experiment that might not work: you'll have room to try things, and we'd rather you tried.

One thing this isn't - a sales role. We don't need someone to push candidates over the line. We need someone who tells our story honestly and specifically enough that the right people lean in and the wrong ones opt out early. That includes the less glamorous parts, like a small distributed team and meetings that stretch into your evening so we can work with the US.

  • A talent community exists around WunderGraph that didn't before: people who know us, follow what we do, and raise their hand when the right role opens.

  • Candidates keep telling us ours is the best hiring process they've been through, including the ones we don't hire. You keep it that way as we hire more.

  • Hiring managers trust your judgement enough to change their minds when you push back on a brief, and leadership trusts the plan because your hiring metrics are clear.

  • Our hiring processes are better because you changed them, not just because you ran them.

ROLE TASKS

The role focuses on, but is not limited to:

Full-cycle recruiting

  • Running multiple searches at once across engineering and non-engineering teams, from intake to accepted offer, prioritised by urgency

  • Running role kickoffs with hiring managers to agree outcomes, competencies and the interview loop

  • Writing job profiles and adverts with the People team, tailored to each audience

  • Coordinating interviews and running debriefs, with blind scorecards in Ashby before any group discussion

  • Keeping every candidate updated, with no one waiting more than 3 days to hear from us

Sourcing

  • Finding and engaging people who aren't looking, through sourcing, open-source projects, communities, meetups and conferences

  • Headhunting directly for senior and hard-to-fill roles

  • Writing outreach specific enough to each person that they actually reply

  • Keeping warm pipelines for roles we hire repeatedly

Stakeholders and reporting

  • Advising hiring managers on market realities: who's available, what they expect, and what that means for the brief

  • Keeping leadership updated with clear hiring metrics and progress

  • Escalating blockers early, with a proposed fix

Talent community and employer marketing

  • Building a community of people who know WunderGraph before they ever see a job post

  • Running creative, low-budget activity: events, content, community-led hiring, the odd meme that lands

  • Working out what worked, and dropping what didn't

Hiring process

  • Improving our interview loops, tasks and scorecards, including for technical roles

  • Documenting our recruitment workflows so they don't live in one person's head

  • Keeping hiring compliant across the countries we hire in, and handling contracts, background checks and documentation with the People team where needed

  • Keeping our hiring data and Ashby setup useful for planning, not just record-keeping23w

ROLE REQUIREMENTS

  • You've run full-cycle recruiting for both technical and non-technical roles, and can walk through searches you owned from brief to accepted offer.

  • You're a strong sourcer. You find people who aren't looking, and your outreach gets replies because it's written for the person reading it.

  • You keep several very different searches moving at once without letting candidate experience slip.

title: System Engineer (all genders) Datacenter Infrastructure
description:
Mit über 650 Kolleg:innen an 19 Standorten in ganz Deutschland gestalten wir bei teccle die Zukunft der IT. Seit 2020 bringen wir starke IT-Unternehmen mit unterschiedlichsten Schwerpunkten unter einem Dach zusammen - und entwickeln uns so zu einem der führenden IT-Dienstleister im Land. Unser Ziel: IT-Lösungen schaffen, die wirklich weiterhelfen - verständlich, flexibel und zukunftsfähig. Für unsere Kund:innen und gemeinsam mit einem Team, das Technik genauso liebt wie neue Ideen.

Als Teil der teccle group steht die teccle motion für ganzheitliche IT-Lösungen rund um Managed Services, Modern Workplace und skalierbare Infrastrukturen. Zur Verstärkung unseres dreiköpfigen Datacenter-Teams suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt Verstärkung für den Betrieb und die Weiterentwicklung unserer IT-Infrastruktur.

Was du bei uns bewegst

Bei uns zählt nicht nur, was du kannst - sondern auch, was du bewirkst. In dieser Rolle trägst du zu folgenden Punkten bei:

  • Betrieb und Weiterentwicklung unserer Datacenter-Infrastruktur – von Servern und Storage über Netzwerkkomponenten bis zur Grundkonfiguration der Systeme

  • Administration und Weiterentwicklung der virtualisierten Infrastruktur mit verschiedenen Hypervisors wie ESXi, Hyper-V und KVM sowie Betreuung der zugrunde liegenden Microsoft- und Linux-Systeme

  • Bedarfsgerechte Skalierung der physischen Infrastruktur auf Basis von Monitoring, Metriken und technischen Auswertungen

  • Automatisierung von Betriebs- und Konfigurationsaufgaben mit Ansible sowie kontinuierliche Optimierung und Standardisierung bestehender Abläufe

  • Betreuung und Weiterentwicklung von Server-, Storage-, Netzwerk- und Backup-Umgebungen, unter anderem mit Dell, Aruba und Veeam

  • Planung und technische Begleitung von Migrationen und Infrastrukturprojekten in enger Zusammenarbeit mit angrenzenden Fachteams

  • Bewertung technischer Anforderungen und Machbarkeit im Angebotsprozess gemeinsam mit PreSales sowie Entwicklung passender Infrastruktur-Lösungen

Womit du bei uns glänzt

Niemand erfüllt jede Anforderung. Wenn du neugierig bist und Lust auf die Aufgabe hast, freuen wir uns auch dann auf deine Bewerbung, wenn nicht alles zu 100% passt.

  • Du bringst mehrjährige Erfahrung mit IT- oder Rechenzentrumsinfrastrukturen und fundiertes Know-how in Server, Storage und Netzwerk mit

  • Du fühlst dich in Windows- und Linux-Umgebungen zuhause und konfigurierst Netzwerk-, Server- und Storage-Komponenten sicher

  • Du hast Erfahrung mit Virtualisierung, z. B. VMware oder Hyper-V, und idealerweise auch mit Backup-Lösungen wie Veeam

  • Du automatisierst bereits mit Ansible oder hast Lust, dich künftig noch stärker mit Automatisierung zu beschäftigen

  • Du arbeitest eigenständig und strukturiert, triffst technische Entscheidungen und bringst Teamgeist sowie Neugier auf neue Technologien mit

  • Du hast einen Führerschein der Klasse B und freust dich auf durchschnittlich ein bis zwei Einsätze pro Monat in unseren Rechenzentren, insbesondere in Nürnberg

  • Du kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch - im Team, mit Kund:innen und im Alltag

  • Du lebst in Nabburg und Umgebung und bist berechtigt in Deutschland zu arbeiten - so können wir im Alltag gut und reibungslos zusammenarbeiten

Darauf kannst du dich freuen

Bei uns bekommst du mehr als nur einen Job. Wir wollen, dass du dich weiterentwickeln, wohlfühlen und mitgestalten kannst. Hier ein paar Gründe, warum du gerne bei uns arbeitest:

  • Mehr Freiheit: 30 Tage Urlaub, flexible Arbeitszeiten und bis zu 25 Tage arbeiten im EU-Ausland

  • Arbeiten, wie es zu dir passt: Ob im Büro oder von zuhause - du entscheidest, was für dich am besten funktioniert

  • Wissen, das weiterbringt: Zertifizierungen, individuelle Weiterbildungen und Raum für deine Entwicklung

  • Willkommenskultur mit Herz: Ein kollegiales Team und echtes Miteinander

  • Gutes Arbeitsumfeld: Moderne Technik und klare Strukturen

  • Sichere und faire Konditionen: attraktives Gehalt, JobRad, betriebliche Altersvorsorge und Unterstützung über meinEAP, unser kostenloses Beratungsangebot - auch für deine Familie

Vielfalt macht uns stärker - deshalb fördern wir bewusst ein Arbeitsumfeld, in dem alle Menschen willkommen sind.
Unabhängig von sozialer oder ethnischer Herkunft, Geschlecht, Alter, Religion oder Weltanschauung, Behinderung, sexueller Identität und Orientierung: Wir bieten allen Bewerbenden einen fairen Prozess und gerechte Chancen. Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen von Menschen, die unsere Haltung zu Vielfalt, Gleichberechtigung und Inklusion teilen – und Lust haben, gemeinsam mit uns eine inklusive Arbeitswelt zu gestalten.

title: Kfz-Meister gesucht – vielleicht ist es Zeit für eine Werkstatt, die wirklich zu dir passt.
description:
Kfz-Meister gesucht – vielleicht ist es Zeit für eine Werkstatt, die wirklich zu dir passt.

Wir sind autoteam augsburg, eine inhabergeführte Kfz-Meisterwerkstatt in Augsburg-Kriegshaber.

Bei uns geht es nicht darum, möglichst viele Fahrzeuge irgendwie durch die Werkstatt zu bekommen. Uns ist wichtig, dass sauber gearbeitet wird, Probleme wirklich gelöst werden und unsere Kunden ihr Fahrzeug mit einem guten Gefühl wieder abholen.

Wir arbeiten an Fahrzeugen aller Marken und decken ein breites Spektrum ab: Inspektionen nach Herstellervorgaben, Diagnose, Bremsen, Motor, Fahrwerk, Klima, Getriebe, Umbauten und vieles mehr. Gerade deshalb ist der Alltag bei uns abwechslungsreich. Kein Tag ist genau wie der andere und wenn ein Fehler nicht sofort auf der Hand liegt, nehmen wir uns die Zeit, ihn wirklich zu finden.

Unsere Werkstatt ist modern und sehr gut ausgestattet. Mehrere Hebebühnen, aktuelle Diagnosetechnik und alles, was man braucht, um ordentlich arbeiten zu können. Gleichzeitig legen wir viel Wert darauf, dass die Werkstatt sauber, gepflegt und ein angenehmer Arbeitsplatz ist. Schließlich verbringt man hier einen großen Teil seines Tages und soll sich auch wohlfühlen.

Für unser Team suchen wir einen Kfz-Meister (m/w/d), der sein Handwerk versteht, gerne Verantwortung übernimmt und Lust auf ein Umfeld hat, in dem gute Arbeit geschätzt wird.

Was wir dir bieten

Bei uns kannst du dein Wissen und deine Erfahrung wirklich einbringen. Du hast die Möglichkeit, Verantwortung zu übernehmen, Entscheidungen mitzutreffen und bei anspruchsvolleren Fällen deine Erfahrung einzusetzen.

Du unterstützt unser Team bei Diagnose und Fehlersuche, behältst die Qualität der Arbeiten im Blick und sorgst gemeinsam mit uns dafür, dass die Abläufe in der Werkstatt stimmen. Wenn du gerne selbst mit am Fahrzeug arbeitest, Fehler suchst und technische Lösungen findest, bist du bei uns genau richtig.

Wir sind ein inhabergeführtes Unternehmen. Das bedeutet bei uns: kurze Wege, direkte Gespräche und schnelle Entscheidungen. Keine Konzernstrukturen, keine unnötigen Umwege und kein Gefühl, nur irgendeine Personalnummer zu sein.

Was wir dir außerdem bieten:

  • einen sicheren und langfristigen Arbeitsplatz

  • eine moderne, saubere und sehr gut ausgestattete Werkstatt

  • abwechslungsreiche Arbeiten an Fahrzeugen aller Marken

  • viel Eigenverantwortung und Vertrauen

  • kurze Entscheidungswege

  • ein angenehmes und kollegiales Arbeitsumfeld

  • eine faire und leistungsgerechte Vergütung

  • Möglichkeiten zur Weiterbildung

  • einen Arbeitsplatz, an dem gute Arbeit gesehen und geschätzt wird

Uns ist wichtig, dass man gerne zur Arbeit kommt, vernünftig miteinander umgeht, sich gegenseitig unterstützt und sich aufeinander verlassen kann. Denn am Ende verbringen wir einen großen Teil unseres Tages miteinander und da sollte nicht nur die Arbeit passen, sondern auch das Miteinander.

Was du mitbringst

Voraussetzung für die Stelle ist ein abgeschlossener Kfz-Meistertitel.

Du kennst den Werkstattalltag, kannst selbstständig arbeiten und übernimmst Verantwortung, wenn es darauf ankommt. Bei schwierigeren Diagnosen oder Fehlerbildern gibst du nicht sofort auf, sondern möchtest verstehen, wo das Problem liegt und wie man es vernünftig löst.

Außerdem wünschen wir uns jemanden, der:

  • sauber und zuverlässig arbeitet

  • einen hohen Anspruch an die eigene Arbeit hat

  • freundlich und respektvoll mit Kunden und Kollegen umgeht

  • sein Fachwissen gerne ins Team einbringt

  • Entscheidungen treffen kann

  • Verantwortung übernimmt

  • und vor allem noch Freude am Kfz-Handwerk hat

Natürlich muss am Ende auch das Menschliche stimmen.

Wir suchen keinen perfekten Lebenslauf. Wir suchen einen guten Meister, der zu uns und zu unserem Team passt.

Wenn du momentan in einer Werkstatt arbeitest und dir schon länger denkst, dass eine Veränderung vielleicht genau das Richtige wäre, dann melde dich einfach bei uns.

Du musst dafür keinen komplizierten Bewerbungsprozess durchlaufen. Komm vorbei, schau dir unsere Werkstatt an und lern uns kennen. Dann sehen wir ganz in Ruhe, ob es für beide Seiten passt.

Munich Electrification is an innovative company founded with the aim of accelerating the transition to electric and connected mobility. As a small and specialized team we are well-aware of the importance of each individual colleague and support and promote each employee according to their abilities and needs. This is what we stand for:

You will lead and mentor a dedicated team of test engineers, taking ultimate responsibility for our overall product quality, test strategy, and process compliance as well as the strategic planning, hiring, and team building of your team. Your strong leadership will be instrumental in building a world-class testing organization and ensuring our products meet the highest standards of safety and excellence, making a significant impact on the future of electric energy storage technology.

As part of your role, you will:

Lead, Empower, and Develop Your Team

  • Take full personnel responsibility for your team, including hiring, onboarding, professional development, and compensation planning.

  • Make sure the test strategy and efforts are aligned with the product roadmap and customer needs.

    Drive Process Excellence and Compliance:

  • Ensure team compliance with critical automotive processes and norms such as ISO 26262, ISO 21434, and ASPICE.

  • Serve as the primary escalation point for any process, quality, or technical concerns from the team.

  • Act as a direct interface for Product and Project Management, Systems and Software Development leadership, and HR to align on strategies and ensure seamless collaboration.

Your Profile

Educational Foundation: Successfully completed university degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a comparable engineering field.

Professional Experience:

  • More than 5 years of professional experience in software quality assurance, validation, or testing, preferably in an automotive embedded systems environment.

  • More than 3 years of experience in a technical leadership, test architecture, or management role, with a proven track record of leading testing efforts for complex products.

Our Offer & Benefits

The chance to be part of a highly innovative, agile, and unique team with prestigious customers in the automotive and battery storage sector.
